interpretation_constraints: Feature contributions describe model predictions rather than causality.
Do not infer physical equipment faults.
Do not equate prediction error with wafer quality classification.
Do not present feature contributions as calibrated prediction uncertainty.
Recommend engineering investigation rather than automatic process adjustment.

limitations: Explainability uses the previously examined original-validation partition.
Gain importance describes training split behaviour.
Permutation may generate unrealistic combinations of correlated inputs.
Correlated predictors can affect importance rankings.
TreeSHAP uses the fitted tree model's native attribution procedure.
Raw-input grouping is post-hoc attribution aggregation.
Feature attribution does not establish physical causality.
Largest-error cases are intentionally selected diagnostic examples.
Local feature contributions do not represent calibrated uncertainty.
Synthetic input checks do not establish predictive reliability.
